content.user_title: Optimize AI Context for Longer Tasks
content.value_statement: Long AI sessions can waste tokens, increase latency, and lose important context. This skill provides practical methods for compaction, masking, caching, partitioning, and budgeting.
actual_capabilities: Selects optimization strategies based on whether tools, documents, or message history dominate token usage.
Defines compaction triggers and summary priorities for long conversations.
Classifies observations for retention, summarization, or reference-based masking.
Orders stable and unique prompt elements to improve prefix-cache reuse.
Allocates context budgets and partitions complex work across isolated agents.
limitations: It provides design guidance and examples, not a runtime context management library.
It cannot increase a model's actual context-window limit.
Recommended reduction and cache targets require validation with each workload.
Aggressive summarization or masking can remove evidence needed for later decisions.

use_cases.title: Reduce production agent costs
use_cases.description: Define token budgets, cache-stable prefixes, and compaction triggers for long-running agent workflows.

use_cases.title: Preserve long research sessions
use_cases.description: Summarize older material while retaining decisions, key facts, citations, and unresolved questions.

use_cases.title: Control verbose tool output
use_cases.description: Replace completed tool observations with compact summaries and retrievable references.

prompt_templates.title: Find the largest context costs
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this agent context: [context]. Identify the largest token consumers and recommend one low-risk optimization.
prompt_templates.scenario: Begin with a focused assessment of an existing context.

prompt_templates.title: Create a compaction plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a compaction plan for [conversation]. Preserve decisions, constraints, unresolved questions, and recent evidence. Set a trigger based on token utilization.
prompt_templates.scenario: Prepare a long conversation for continued work.

prompt_templates.title: Design an observation policy
prompt_templates.prompt: Design an observation-masking policy for [workflow]. Classify outputs as retain, summarize, or reference. Define retrieval rules for masked details.
prompt_templates.scenario: Reduce repeated tool output without losing access to evidence.

prompt_templates.title: Architect a context system
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a measured context architecture for [system]. Include budgets, cache-stable prefixes, partition boundaries, compaction triggers, quality checks, and rollback criteria.
prompt_templates.scenario: Build an advanced production strategy across multiple context techniques.

output_examples.input: Our support agent exceeds its context limit after many tool calls.
output_examples.output: Mask resolved tool outputs after three turns. Keep recent evidence, customer constraints, open actions, and compact references for retrieval.

output_examples.input: Plan compaction for a research conversation at 82 percent utilization.
output: Preserve claims, citations, decisions, and unresolved questions.
Summarize older discussion and duplicate source extracts.
Retain the latest turns and reserve capacity for synthesis.

output_examples.input: Improve cache reuse for repeated agent requests.
output_examples.output: Place the system prompt and tool definitions first. Follow with reused templates, then request-specific content. Remove dynamic timestamps from stable prefixes.

best_practices: Measure token use, latency, cache hits, and answer quality before changing the context strategy.
Preserve recent evidence, active constraints, decisions, and unresolved questions during compaction.
Test optimization thresholds with representative production workloads and define rollback criteria.
anti_patterns: Do not summarize the entire context without identifying information that must remain exact.
Do not mask recent observations or evidence supporting an active decision.
Do not add timestamps or request-specific data to otherwise stable prompt prefixes.

faq.question: Does this skill increase a model's context limit?
faq.answer: No. It helps use the existing context window more efficiently.

faq.question: When should compaction begin?
faq.answer: Start planning near 70 percent utilization and consider triggering compaction near 80 percent. Validate thresholds for your workload.

faq.question: What information should summaries preserve?
faq.answer: Preserve decisions, constraints, key facts, metrics, citations, unresolved questions, and details required for current reasoning.

faq.question: What is observation masking?
faq.answer: It replaces verbose, completed tool output with a compact summary or reference that can support later retrieval.

faq.question: How does prompt ordering improve caching?
faq.answer: Stable system instructions and tool definitions create reusable prefixes. Unique request content appears later, so shared computation can be cached.

faq.question: How should optimization quality be measured?
faq.answer: Track token reduction, latency, cache-hit rate, task accuracy, evidence retention, and failures caused by missing context.
